intuition.title: Study context: Emulsion formulation
intuition.text: The phase diagram guided selection of 15/60/25 wt% surfactant/oil/aqueous phases. Only the neodymium feed has total charged masses; receiver amount and mixing ratio remain unknown.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental procedure and Figure 1

intuition.title: Study context: Particle/film separation
intuition.text: The TEM/SAED evidence describes oxide particles. Composite-film and host-only PL curves are separate source contexts, not additional independently characterized nanoparticle batches.

intuition.title: Study context: Host and temperature effects
intuition.text: Residual water/organics, pore formation and surfactant passivation are proposed explanations. The 1145 nm shoulder is tentatively attributed to the host; the source states that its mechanism is unclear.

scopeLabel: Complete supplied four-page main, four figures and 19 bibliography entries. SI and cited full sources unreviewed. One reported oxide preparation; receiving-emulsion charge/mixing ratio remains unknown. No equal-charge assumption. Independent source comparison passed; presentation pending.

bindings.caption: Mix 30.22 g NP-5/NP-9 (2:1 mass ratio), 120.88 g cyclohexane and 50.36 g of 0.5 M aqueous neodymium nitrate in a stoppered Erlenmeyer flask. Reported respective phase fractions are 15, 60 and 25 wt%. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

Prepare the receiving microemulsion with NP-5/NP-9 (2:1 mass ratio) 15 wt%, cyclohexane 60 wt% and 0.5 M aqueous oxalic acid 25 wt%. Its total charge and relative amount versus the feed are not reported. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

Slowly add the clear neodymium microemulsion to the oxalic-acid microemulsion. No numeric addition rate or receiver charge is given. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.
Slowly stir the clear combined mixture for ten minutes; stirring speed is unreported. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.
Allow the stirred mixture to remain overnight. The source supplies no numerical standing duration. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.
Remove the precipitated fine powder by centrifugation; time and rotation/acceleration are not specified. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.
Wash recovered powder with absolute ethanol at least five times; each wash charge is unreported. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.
Dry under vacuum for one day at 75 °C. The isolated neodymium oxalate amount, hydration and vacuum pressure are unreported. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

Calcine the dry neodymium oxalate at 600 °C for 1 h to obtain Nd2O3 nanoparticles. Heating ramp, atmosphere and recovered oxide yield are not given. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

sourceAudit.scope: Independent complete four-page main source, Reader, figure and apparatus audit passed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.

general_background.title: Reaction in dispersed liquid domains
general_background.summary: Microemulsions organize reactants into small liquid domains separated by interfaces. Exchange between domains and interfacial chemistry can matter alongside the chemistry within each domain.
